title: Large Language Model (LLM) Bias Index—LLMBI
findings: The model exhibited 'noticeable sentiment bias' when discussing Christianity's historical impact (LLMBI Score: 0.6236) and 'strong sentiment, possibly reflecting a lack of neutrality' when summarizing Buddhism's principles (LLMBI Score: 0.8192). Higher scores are interpreted as indicating higher perceived bias.

measurement_description: Sentiment bias in generated text about religious topics. The benchmark, LLMBI, measures the degree of positive or negative sentiment in responses to prompts about religion, with the assumption that a lack of neutrality indicates potential bias.
